Ran a no-declaration-keyword grep (grep -LE against theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom) over all 169 in-scope files: 35 files flagged. Determined this is a false-positive-prone heuristic here because the repo defines its own Lean DSL (fork, forkdef, forkcontainer, forkabbrev, forkpreset, inherit, state_section, state_preamble, signedwrapper) whose macro names contain 'def' etc. as a contiguous substring without a preceding word boundary, so \b-anchored keyword matching misses genuine declarations; confirmed directly by grepping packages/EthCLLib/EthCLLib/Tests/InheritanceReplay.lean, which has zero literal keyword matches but is a real elaboration-semantics test file.

Read all 35 no-keyword-flagged files in full or near-full (head -c 900-1200 plus targeted full reads for the shorter ones): 7 are legitimate FILTER-007 pure-import aggregator/root files with no declarations of their own (EthCLLib/EthCLLib.lean, EthCLLib/EthCLLib/Proofs.lean, EthCLSpecs/EthCLSpecs/Heze.lean, EthCLSpecs/EthCLSpecs/Heze/Containers.lean, EthCLSpecs/EthCLSpecs/Gloas/Containers.lean, EthCLSpecs/EthCLSpecsBench.lean, SizzLean/SizzLeanBench.lean); the remaining 28 are genuine DSL-based formal declarations (forkdef/forkcontainer/inherit/fork-lineage content across Fulu/Gloas/Heze Deposits/Block/Fork/State/Transition/EpochProcessing modules, a signedwrapper macro definition in EthCLSpecs/Forms.lean) or genuine #guard-based elaboration-semantics self-tests (EthCLLib/Tests/InheritanceReplay.lean and others). None is a stub, generated table, or non-mathematical filler file.

Read scripts/ProofCoverage.lean (head 80 lines, tail 40 lines, 44986 bytes, 128 keyword-grep hits): a substantive Lean program (not build config) that walks the compiled Environment via importModules (loadExts := true), uses Lean.CollectAxioms.collect, and computes a three-tier (executable/touched/characterized) proof-coverage report keyed on the repo's captureExt/characterizesExt extensions, with a documented CLI (--check/--update). Retained: this is real engineering logic with unique content, not build/config DSL, so it does not meet FILTER-004's no-formal-declarations exclusion bar.

Read the 17 remaining named candidate Tests/Bench/PySpecTests files not covered above: EthCLSpecs/Tests/GloasForkChoicePins.lean, HezeCommitteesPins.lean, HezeForkChoicePins.lean (build-enforced #guard/native_decide conformance pins for fork-choice and committee helpers, each with a documented rationale for living in a separate Tests library), EthCLSpecsBench/Profile.lean and ProfileMain.lean (a real per-container profiling tool over an upstream mainnet SSZ vector, and its exe driver), EthCLSpecs/PySpecTests/Server.lean (the long-lived pyspec conformance server implementing a documented wire protocol), SizzLeanBench/CompBench/Fixture.lean, Hashers.lean, Scenarios.lean, CompBenchMain.lean, Fulu.lean, MultiState.lean, MultiStateMain.lean (a documented cross-library comparative SSZ benchmark against Python and Rust implementations, plus a hash-consing heap benchmark), SizzLeanTests.lean (a pure-import root aggregating 13+ test modules), SizzLeanTests/ElementSurface.lean, HashConsCoherence.lean, ReprExamples.lean (documented acceptance-gate test files for the collection API, hash-consing cache, and SSZRepr typeclass). Every one of these 17 files has a substantive module docstring and real declaration content (1-48 keyword-grep hits each); none is filler, a stub, or generated output.

Sampled unread core directories to confirm full directory coverage: packages/SizzLean/SizzLean/Cache/Box.lean, Cache/MerkleTree/Build.lean, Cache/MerkleTree/HashCons.lean (genuine cache/Merkle-tree implementation code, 5-24 keyword hits each) and packages/EthCLSpecs/EthCLSpecs/Proofs/Fulu.lean, Proofs/Fulu/Balances.lean, Proofs/Fulu/Run.lean (a proofs-index pure-import file plus two genuine theorem files about pyspec balance-mutator semantics, 2-12 keyword hits).
